editorial:
Imagine being trapped in your own house while a whole army of killers tries to break in to collect a bounty on your head. That is exactly the mess Everly finds herself in after she decides to double-cross a scary mob boss. You get to follow her as she turns her home into a giant trap, using everything she can find to fight off wave after wave of attackers. It feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, but the cat is actually the one getting scratched. The vibe is gritty and loud, keeping you on the edge of your seat without getting too bogged down in a slow plot.

What really makes this work is the non-stop action and the way the lead actress handles the physical fights. While the plot is simple, the pacing is fast and the kills are creative. A few parts feel a bit repetitive, but if you love over-the-top fights, you will have a blast. It is the perfect choice for a weekend binge when you just want to see bad guys get beaten up.
endingExplained: In the final act, Everly manages to take out almost every hitman sent after her. She eventually faces off against the mob boss himself in a brutal showdown. After a long and bloody fight, she wins and kills the boss, finally securing her safety. The movie wraps up with her surviving the nightmare and getting the chance to protect her family, proving that she was way tougher than the criminals ever expected.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves home invasion movies and female-led action flicks.
